newsitem.title: PERU: Peru Power Holdings, Luz del Sur sign contract.
newsitem.headline: Peru Power Holdings, Luz del Sur sign contract.

text.p: Peru Power Holdings Inc. said Tuesday it will build a 500 megawatt (MW) power plant to comply with a new contract to sell electricity to Peruvian distributor Luz del Sur.
Peru Power said it will invest $200 million to build the plant in Piura, 650 miles (1,050 km) north of Lima, scheduled to begin operations at the start of 1998.
The electricity generator said it estimated the sales contract signed with Luz del Sur was worth more than $1 billion. The company did not give more details of the contract.
Luz del Sur was made a blue chip stock on the Lima stock exchange in January.
